news.title: What Changed In Marvell's Story?
news.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock returned 201% in the past year, against 17.7% for the S&P 500. Investors value it as an AI data center chip company at 85.6 times earnings, versus 22.1 for the S&P 500. Investors paying that multiple are counting on data center growth staying fast. Management used to tell a second growth story too, and it no longer leads with that story. So what did Marvell's management stop leading with.
news.title_zh: Marvell 的故事發生了什麼變化？
news.summary_zh: 過去一年，Marvell Technology (MRVL) 股票回報率為 201%，而標普 500 指數僅為 17.7%。投資者將其視為一家 AI 數據中心晶片公司，以 85.6 倍的收益交易，而標普 500 指數為 22.1。支付該倍數的投資者正在期待數據中心增長保持快速。管理層過去也曾講述第二個增長故事，但現在不再以此為主導故事。因此，Marvell 的管理層停止以什麼為主導故事。

news.title: Is Cerebras' Next Big Thing Already Here?
news.summary: Cerebras Systems (CBRS) sells AI hardware and rents out computing power through its own cloud. The shares trade 37.3% below their 52-week high, even though management raised its 2026 revenue forecast in August. Cerebras still reports a loss. Anyone buying the shares today is paying for growth still to come. So how much of that growth has Cerebras already signed.
news.title_zh: Cerebras 的下一個大事已經到來嗎？
news.summary_zh: Cerebras Systems (CBRS) 銷售 AI 硬體並通過其自身雲端租賃計算能力。該股票的交易價格比其 52 周高點低 37.3%，儘管管理層在 8 月上調了 2026 年的收入預測。 Cerebras 仍報告虧損。任何今天購買該股票的人都在為尚未到來的增長支付費用。因此，Cerebras 已經簽訂了多少增長。

news.title: What Is The True Hidden Price Of Marvell Stock?
news.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock, at $263.27 a share (September 29, 2026 close) and a market value of about $231 billion, trades at 80 times its past twelve months of adjusted earnings per share. That is steep for one year of profit, but Marvell's sales are growing fast, so the next two years matter more. What, then, is the real price of Marvell stock once you count the profit expected in those years.

news.title: Prediction: Rambus Could Be a Quiet Winner From Exploding AI Demand
news.summary: Rambus sits far below its 52-week high while AI server builders keep adding racks that depend on its chips. Whether the stock is a overlooked opportunity or a value trap comes down to a few critical revenue milestones in the quarters ahead.
